name: Cloud Reverb
_comment: Insert effect: a light reverb for long ambient tails with five TYPEs (cloudreverb_core.h). "effect": true makes gen_vst.py list it as an insert effect (as in mpc-vst-rat). vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is cloudreverb_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh.
